steps.instruction: Hang from the jugs for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Jug hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 1 rest

steps.instruction: Do 1 pull-up on a round sloper.
steps.title: Round sloper pull-up

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 2 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 10 seconds.
steps.title: Medium-edge hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 3 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a pocket for 15 seconds and include 3 shrugs.
steps.title: Pocket hang + shrugs

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 4 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a large edge for 20 seconds and include 2 pull-ups.
steps.title: Large edge + pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 5 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for 10 seconds.
steps.title: Round-sloper hang

steps.instruction: Do 5 knee raises on a pocket.
steps.title: Pocket knee raises

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 6 rest

steps.instruction: Do 4 pull-ups on a large edge.
steps.title: Large-edge pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 7 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 10 seconds.
steps.title: Medium-edge hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 8 rest

steps.instruction: Do 3 pull-ups on the jugs.
steps.title: Jug pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 9 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for as long as you can.
steps.title: Maximum sloper hang

steps.instruction: Hang from a large edge for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Large-edge hang

steps.instruction: Do 3 pull-ups on the large edge.
steps.title: Large-edge pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 1 rest

steps.instruction: Do 2 pull-ups on a round sloper.
steps.title: Round sloper pull-ups

steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 20 seconds.
steps.title: Medium-edge hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 2 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a small edge for 20 seconds.
steps.title: Small-edge hang

steps.instruction: Hold a pocket at a 90° bent arm for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Bent-arm pocket hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 3 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for 30 seconds.
steps.title: Round-sloper hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 4 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a large edge for 20 seconds.
steps.title: Large-edge hang

steps.instruction: Do 4 pull-ups on a pocket.
steps.title: Pocket pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 5 rest

steps.instruction: Do 3 offset pulls with the high hand on a jug and low hand on a small edge.
steps.title: Offset pulls

steps.instruction: Change hands and repeat 3 offset pulls with the high hand on a jug and low hand on a small edge.
steps.title: Offset pulls · other side

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 6 rest

steps.instruction: Do 15 knee raises on the jugs.
steps.title: Jug knee raises

steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Medium-edge hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 7 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 25 seconds.
steps.title: Medium-edge hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 8 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a slope for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Slope hang

steps.instruction: Do 3 pull-ups on the jugs.
steps.title: Jug pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 9 rest

steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for as long as you can.
steps.title: Maximum sloper hang

steps.instruction: Hold a straight-arm hang on a large slope for 20 seconds.
steps.title: Large-slope hang

steps.instruction: Do 3 pull-ups on a four-finger flat edge.
steps.title: Four-finger flat-edge pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 1 rest

steps.instruction: Hold a slightly bent-arm hang on a large slope for 20 seconds.
steps.title: Bent-arm large-slope hang

steps.instruction: Stay on for a 20-second L-sit or 20 hanging knee curls.
steps.title: L-sit or hanging knee curls

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 2 rest

steps.instruction: Do 5 pull-ups on a three-finger pocket.
steps.title: Three-finger-pocket pull-ups

steps.instruction: Stay on for a 25-second straight-arm hang on the same three-finger pocket.
steps.title: Straight-arm three-finger-pocket hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 3 rest

steps.instruction: Start at a three-finger pocket and move through every hold upward, staying on each for 5 seconds; finish with a 20-second large-slope hang.
steps.title: Hold ladder

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 4 rest

steps.instruction: Hang one-armed from a four-finger flat edge for 20 seconds.
steps.title: Single-arm flat-edge hang

steps.instruction: Switch hands and repeat the 20-second one-armed hang from a four-finger flat edge.
steps.title: Single-arm flat-edge hang · other hand

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 5 rest

steps.instruction: Do 5 offset pull-ups with the top hand on a large slope and bottom hand on a three-finger pocket.
steps.title: Offset pull-ups

steps.instruction: Change hands and repeat 5 offset pull-ups with the top hand on a large slope and bottom hand on a three-finger pocket.
steps.title: Offset pull-ups · other side

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 6 rest

steps.instruction: Hold a 90° bent-arm hang on a four-finger incut edge for 30 seconds.
steps.title: Incut-edge bent-arm hang

steps.instruction: Then hold a straight-arm three-finger-pocket hang for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Straight-arm three-finger-pocket hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 7 rest

steps.instruction: Do 3 L-sit pull-ups, bending your knees if needed.
steps.title: L-sit pull-ups

steps.accessory: Choose one · 5 seconds front lever OR 15 seconds straight-arm large-slope hang
steps.instruction: Choose one: hold a 5-second front lever or 15-second straight-arm hang on a large slope. If choosing the front lever, finish at 5 seconds; do not perform both.
steps.title: Choose one: front lever or straight-arm hang

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 8 rest

steps.instruction: Hang straight-armed for 20 seconds using only 2 fingers in three-finger pockets.
steps.title: Two-finger three-finger-pocket hang

steps.instruction: Then do 3 power pull-ups with weight or helper resistance.
steps.title: Power pull-ups

steps.instruction: Rest for the remainder of the minute.
steps.title: Minute 9 rest

steps.instruction: Do a maximum slightly bent-arm hang on a large slope to failure with no rest, then a maximum straight-arm hang on the large slope.
steps.title: Maximum slope hangs

steps.instruction: Hang for 7 seconds on a 20 mm edge in a half-crimp, four-finger position at near-maximal intensity.
